meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多步 AI 任务的计划、发现和进度存到磁盘,中断后还能接着做
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常让 AI 跑十几步的任务,担心中途跑偏或丢失进度。
copy.tagline_en: Save plans, findings, and progress to disk so long AI tasks can resume after interruption
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your AI tasks run many steps and you fear losing progress midway.

howto.what: Claude 会在你的项目目录里建 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件,把计划、发现和进度写进去;每完成一个阶段就更新状态,上下文丢失或被清掉后还能照这些文件接着做。
howto.when: 当你要求拆解、规划或组织多步项目、调研任务,或任务预计需要 5 次以上工具调用时接管;它也会在你每次提交提示、以及上下文压缩前注入当前计划文件的内容。

say.text: 帮我规划这个多步项目,先建好 task_plan.md
say.note: 会生成计划文件并列出阶段

say.text: 先读一下 task_plan.md,再决定下一步怎么做
把这次的进度和发现更新到 progress.md 和 findings.md
say.note: 会追加会话日志与发现

howto.what_en: Claude keeps three files in your project — task_plan.md, findings.md and progress.md — writing plans, findings and progress to disk and updating them after each phase, so work survives context loss or /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan, break down or organize a multi-step project or research task, or any work needing 5+ tool calls. It also injects plan context on each prompt and before compaction.

say_en.text: Plan this multi-step project and create task_plan.md first.
say_en.note: Creates the plan file and lists phases.

say_en.text: Read task_plan.md before deciding the next step.
Log this session's progress and findings to the files.
